integrity: Proof uses exact graph counts and finite-space core theorem; independent scientific audit not performed. Standalone computations test 100 roots in four designs, not an exhaustive classification of all designs.
scientific_limitations: Steiner 2-designs of pair multiplicity one only; an independently verified enumeration of all 80 nonisomorphic 15-point systems is not supplied here; priority relative to unindexed sources is not guaranteed.
title: Complete furtherness barcodes of Steiner incidence spaces
